reason: Need at least 100 independently reviewed, source-linked labels before temporal model evaluation.

requiredGates.split: time-ordered; no future observations; duplicate events stay together
requiredGates.quality: macro-F1 >= 0.70 and >= baseline + 0.05; report class precision/recall; ECE <= 0.10 for probabilistic outputs
requiredGates.humanReview: At least 20% independently double reviewed; record disagreements
requiredGates.alerts: source-linked, deduplicated; 7-day shadow observation; no trading recommendations

limitations: SEC form classification is a deterministic metadata rule, not AI sentiment.
Official company announcements and social opinions have different source biases.
No social API, sentiment ground truth or paid model service connected.
